values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Check-in after 3 pm; the registering camper must be 18+. Tents and pop-ups without sewer hookups are not allowed on full-hookup sites.

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica (state:NY row, now on the entry) with the 9-month window, same-day until 3 pm, walk-ins allowed, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max. Added 30 A electric (84 sites) with water/sewer at 39 full-hookup sites, 165 sites to 40 ft (all back-in), showers, dump. Campground closed for the season (2026 season May 1 - Oct 11; 2027 May 7 - Oct 10, matching the stored season). Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: pull-throughs.
